title: Model multiple EUR shop category replay events
platforms: Linux interpreter and modeled replay dispatch; GUI untested
changes: Extend the isolated shop category replay comparison to three spaced changes and a return to the initial category.
validation: Events 1025, 1026 and 1024 reproduced category sequence 0 to 1 to 2 to 0 with matching serialized-state hashes and clocks for 240 completed frames; protected inputs unchanged.
limitations: The model bypasses the rejecting parser and missing application dispatcher; it does not cover rapid changes, physical input, item selection, native, USA or GUI. Two unused-code warnings.
Managed cleanup rejects non-rom-data U31 units; diagnostic evidence remains isolated.
